content.value_statement: Finding a memorable domain across suitable extensions takes time and repeated comparison. This skill generates focused options and organizes practical checks before registration.
actual_capabilities: Generates domain name candidates from a project description, audience, and keywords.
Adapts suggestions to preferred extensions, industries, languages, and naming constraints.
Explains each candidate using clarity, memorability, pronunciation, and brand fit.
Ranks leading options and proposes variations when preferred names are unavailable.
Provides workflows for checking availability, pricing, social handles, and trademark conflicts.
limitations: The skill includes no scripts, API clients, or registrar integration for live availability checks.
Domain status and pricing examples may be stale or hypothetical, so users must verify them with a registrar.
Trademark guidance is informational and does not replace professional legal clearance.
Generated names may conflict with existing brands, products, social handles, or local language meanings.

use_cases.title: Name a New Startup
use_cases.description: Generate concise domain options aligned with a product, audience, and preferred extensions.

use_cases.title: Explore Rebranding Options
use_cases.description: Compare memorable names and variations before testing them with customers and checking legal conflicts.

use_cases.title: Create a Personal Domain
use_cases.description: Develop professional domain variations based on a name, role, specialty, and preferred TLD.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Starter List
prompt_templates.prompt: I am building [project] for [audience]. Suggest 12 memorable domain names and explain each choice briefly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when you need broad ideas without strict constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Naming Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate domain ideas for [project]. Keep names under [length] characters, include [keywords], avoid [terms], and prioritize [TLDs].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when brand rules or extension preferences are already defined.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Shortlisted Names
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these domain candidates: [names]. Score clarity, spelling, pronunciation, memorability, audience fit, and extension fit. Recommend the strongest three.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this after creating a shortlist.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Naming Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a domain naming strategy for [business]. Analyze audience language and competitor patterns, then generate candidates and a verification checklist.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a structured naming process before registration and legal review.

output_examples.input: Create domain ideas for a remote team planning application.
output: TeamLoom.com: Suggests coordinated work and is easy to pronounce.
PlanRelay.app: Connects planning with team handoffs.
SyncRoster.io: Emphasizes coordination and shared schedules.
Recommendation: Verify registrar status, social handles, and trademark conflicts before selection.

output_examples.input: Suggest short domains for an AI writing assistant using .ai.
output: Draftly.ai: Clear writing association with a concise sound.
WordPilot.ai: Positions the product as guided writing support.
EditSpark.ai: Signals rapid improvement and creative assistance.
Recommendation: Test spelling aloud and confirm current availability.

output_examples.input: Compare BrightLedger.com, LedgerNest.com, and ClearBooks.io for a finance product.
output: BrightLedger.com: Strong clarity and trust, but slightly formal.
LedgerNest.com: Memorable and approachable, with a broader brand feel.
ClearBooks.io: Direct and modern, but less distinctive.
Top choice: BrightLedger.com, subject to availability and trademark review.

best_practices: Describe the product, audience, tone, required keywords, and preferred extensions.
Verify every shortlisted domain with a registrar immediately before making a decision.
Check pronunciation, spelling, trademarks, social handles, and unintended meanings across target markets.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated availability labels or price estimates as current registrar data.
Do not select a name solely because it is short or uses a popular extension.
Do not register a candidate before checking trademark conflicts and confusing similarities.

faq.question: Does this skill check live domain availability?
faq.answer: No built-in checker or registrar integration is included. Confirm every candidate with a registrar or another current lookup service.

faq.question: Which domain extensions can it consider?
faq.answer: It can suggest common and industry-specific extensions, including .com, .io, .dev, .ai, .app, .co, .design, and .tech.

faq.question: Can it estimate domain prices?
faq.answer: It can provide general pricing context, but registrar fees and premium prices change. Obtain a current quote before purchasing.

faq.question: Can it help with trademark checks?
faq.answer: It can provide a screening checklist, but it cannot provide legal clearance. Consult official registries and qualified counsel.

faq.question: Can it create multilingual domain ideas?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the target languages, countries, audience, and words to include or avoid.

faq.question: What information produces better suggestions?
faq.answer: Share the product purpose, audience, desired tone, keywords, forbidden terms, length limit, preferred extensions, and examples you like.
